Name: Immer
ModernLocation: Unknown; in Babylonia, exact site not stated
Description: A place in Babylonia from which exiles returned with Zerubbabel, listed alongside Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub and Addan; those from Immer could not prove their ancestry and so were kept from the priesthood until a priest could consult Urim and Thummim.
BiblicalSignificance: Immer marks the honest edge of the return: a community that came home but could not prove its line, and waited for God's answer rather than forcing one.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
